svg.title: A job behind Harden-Runner
svg.desc: Harden-Runner blocks every host that the job doesn't name. A job that keeps sudo first takes GitHub's DNS experiment out of the way, so that Harden-Runner sees its lookups. The job then asks each of its hosts every 3 seconds, for two minutes at most, until Harden-Runner lets it through, and runs its steps. Without sudo and Docker, it waits until Harden-Runner has removed Docker. A job that ends is done. One that hangs until its time limit ends as cancelled, and a bot runs its cancelled jobs once more; when that hangs too, a required check stays cancelled for you, and a bot gets an issue.
